## rate

Rate Ai Answer. `POST /ai-answers/{event_id}/rate`

Rate an AI answer 👍 / 👎 / ✗ (upsert — re-rating replaces).

down and wrong REQUIRE reason_category: a verdict with no reason cannot drive the correction loop and only produces noise in the score.

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiAnswers()->rate(eventId: 'event_id', verdict: 'verdict');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:write`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$eventId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$verdict` | `string` | yes | up \| down \| wrong |
| `$reasonCategory` | `?string` | no | Required for down/wrong: factually_wrong \| outdated \| incomplete \| off_topic \| wrong_tone \| policy_violation \| hallucinated |
| `$comment` | `?string` | no |  |
| `$betterAnswer` | `?string` | no | What the answer should have said |
| `$sourceAttribution` | `list<string>\|null` | no | faq_items.id values the rater explicitly blames. Takes full weight with no sharing (ignored for 'up' verdicts). |
| `$idempotencyKey` | `?string` | no | Repeat a request safely: SendSeven answers a repeat with the first result. One is generated when omitted. |

Returns `AiAnswerRate`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/AI%20Answers/rate_ai_answer_api_v1_ai_answers__event_id__rate_post)

## listConversation

List Conversation Ai Answers. `GET /conversations/{conversation_id}/ai-answers`

List AI answers generated in a conversation.

The rating UI renders a control next to a *message*, so results are also filterable by message_id — that is the key the frontend holds.

```php
$result = $sendseven->aiAnswers()->listConversation(conversationId: 'conversation_id');
```

- Scopes: `conversations:read`

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `$conversationId` | `string` | yes |  |
| `$messageId` | `?string` | no | Only the event that produced this message |
| `$page` | `?int` | no |  |
| `$pageSize` | `?int` | no |  |

Returns `Page<AiAnswerEvent>`. [SendSeven reference](https://api.sendseven.com/api/v1/docs#/AI%20Answers/list_conversation_ai_answers_api_v1_conversations__conversation_id__ai_answers_get)
